title: Two reconcile tests failed once in one local full-suite run and never again: record, and investigate on recurrence
description: During PR #92's local full-suite run (2026-09-28, host load 90-140), TestAWaveOfTwoTicksDeclaringTheSameFileIsRefusedAtDispatch saw 1 dispatch instead of 0 and TestADispatchGoesThroughTheExecutorItsProfileNames saw 6 instead of 5. An hour of stress (race and non-race, -parallel 4..16, -cpu 1,4, -count up to 40, whole package and isolated) never reproduced either on f72b79a3. Code reading found no path to either count on main (reconciler single-threaded; per-test state). The only log (scratchpad full.log) shows two runs' output interleaved and later failures only a partial checkout could produce (missing cloudflare/test/fixtures/classify-tick-decision.json), so the run may not have been on a complete tree of main. If either fails again anywhere, capture the directory, commit and full -v output and reopen the investigation; the stress harness to reuse is: go test -c then -race -count=20 -parallel 8 -run '<name>'.
acceptance_criteria: Closed when either test fails again with full evidence and the cause is fixed, or after 30 days without a recurrence
